# The status checks `main`'s branch protection requires, recorded here so a check can read them.
#
# GitHub holds the real list and reading it needs admin on the repository — a workflow's own token
# gets 403 — so this file is a copy kept by hand. Editing the settings page without editing this
# file, or the other way round, is the mistake it exists to catch.
#
# `check-example-wiring` asserts that every name below is a check some workflow can still produce.
# That is what would have caught #793: renaming four example directories renamed four required
# contexts, and a required check that is never reported is never satisfied, so the next release
# fast-forward to `main` would have been refused. `next` is unprotected, so nothing before that
# push would have said a word.
#
# One context per line. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
